source: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements — Vitamin D Fact Sheet for Health Professionals
text: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D is the main indicator of vitamin D status. Concentrations below 20 ng/mL are generally considered deficient for bone and overall health, and low sun exposure is a common contributing factor.

source: NIH Office of Dietary Supplements — Vitamin D Fact Sheet for Health Professionals
text: The tolerable upper intake level for adults is 4000 IU per day. Sustained intakes above this can cause hypercalcemia. Routine supplementation is usually given at standard, not high, doses.
